```python
import re
from fractions import Fraction

source = (
    "Das Naturdenkmal Čertovy skály ist eine 0,15 ha große durch starke "
    "Wassererosion gezeichnete Sandsteinformation, die in diesem Gebiet "
    "auch als Magura-Flysch bezeichnet wird."
)
translation = (
    "The natural monument of the town is a 0.15 km sand stone information "
    "marked by severe water erosion, which in this area is also referred "
    "to as Magura-Flysch."
)
options = {
    "A": "Modifiers or Adjectives",
    "B": "Numerical Values",
    "C": "Negation or Antonyms",
    "D": "Named Entities",
    "E": "Dropped Content",
    "F": "Facts",
}
submitted = "D"

# Extract the monument's designation from the corresponding noun phrases.
source_match = re.search(r"Naturdenkmal (.*?) ist", source)
translation_match = re.search(r"natural monument (.*?) is", translation)
source_entity = source_match.group(1)
translated_designation = translation_match.group(1)

entity_changed = (
    source_entity == "Čertovy skály"
    and source_entity.casefold() not in translation.casefold()
    and translated_designation == "of the town"
)

# Independently check the numeric expression and the physical unit.
source_measure = re.search(r"(\d+,\d+)\s+(ha)\b", source)
target_measure = re.search(r"(\d+\.\d+)\s+(km)\b", translation)
source_value = Fraction(source_measure.group(1).replace(",", "."))
target_value = Fraction(target_measure.group(1))
source_unit = source_measure.group(2)
target_unit = target_measure.group(2)
dimensions = {"ha": "area", "km": "length"}
unit_error = dimensions[source_unit] != dimensions[target_unit]

print("Submitted option:", submitted, "-", options[submitted])
print("Source monument name:", source_entity)
print("Translated designation:", translated_designation)
print("Named-entity replacement detected:", entity_changed)
print("Source measurement:", source_value, source_unit)
print("Translated measurement:", target_value, target_unit)
print("Numeric magnitude unchanged:", source_value == target_value)
print("Unit mismatch:", unit_error, "(area versus length)")

if submitted == "D" and entity_changed:
    print("CHECK PASS: D identifies a demonstrable named-entity error.")
else:
    print("CHECK FAIL: the submitted named-entity classification is not supported.")

if entity_changed and unit_error:
    print("The text also contains a B (Numerical Values) error: ha became km.")
    print("UNSUPPORTED: treating D as the uniquely applicable option.")
```
